mapper.insert: insert into code_snippet (code_category_id, title, code_content, create_time) values (#{codeCategoryId}, #{title}, #{codeContent}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select code_snippet_id, code_category_id, title, code_content, create_time from code_snippet where title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or code_content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by create_time desc
